title: ResultSafe Core staging entrypoint
summary: Authoritative read order and interpretation rules for the ResultSafe Core v001 staging corpus.

interpretation_rules: Normative requirements override summaries and implementation behavior
Canonical JSON records override generated documentation and database projections
UUIDv7 identifies an entity but does not establish trusted chronology or ordering
A public handle, package locator, or identifier is never an authorization capability
NOT_EXECUTED and DEFERRED are never equivalent to PASS
Contract IR owns canonical operation semantics and required callable surfaces
FAILURE-MODEL.json owns the optional structured Failure payload while Contract IR retains unconstrained Result error E
The projection catalog owns exact language spellings and support aliases derived from Contract IR
Runtime code, generated documentation, and prose are conformance evidence and do not own semantics or language spellings

A language projection may PASS only when every applicable neutral operation-surface cell in CONFORMANCE-MATRIX.json has exact packed-artifact evidence for the current Contract IR and projection revisions
The TypeScript extension scenarios are TypeScript evidence and must never be represented as cross-language proof
AASDVGS admission requires separate governed authority and is not implied by this corpus
CAUSE-MODEL.json owns optional binary Cause semantics without changing generic Result.
EXIT-MODEL.json owns optional Exit semantics and permits Failure with Empty Cause.
EFFECT-COMPATIBILITY.json describes semantic mappings only and never representation identity.
CORE-MODULARITY-POLICY.json governs the dependency-free root-plus-subpath package boundary.
PUBLIC-MODULE-REGISTRY.json owns the intended public module inventory; package manifests and packed artifacts are conformance evidence.
OPTIONAL-INTEGRATIONS.json owns exact optional package paths, peer dependency policy, supported external versions, vectors, and implementation evidence status.
Effect executable mapping authority belongs to @resultsafe/adapter-core-fp-effect, not the core-only Cause and Exit scenarios.
Effect 3.22.1 and Cause/Exit claims are QUALIFIED_LOCAL_SNAPSHOT by PASS_LOCAL_ATOMIC evidence; release approval, promotion, publication, security, and long-running claims remain excluded.
payload.staging_warning: This corpus is mutable staging evidence and is not an immutable canonical release until approved and promoted.
